summary: Fixed Nora sometimes playing a stale leftover track instead of the song just requested, while claiming the new request was playing.
details: A guild whose prior music session was discarded at boot (channel gone, or emptied while Nora was down) kept its queued tracks in the database forever. The next, unrelated play request enqueued behind that leftover instead of starting it, and Nora's reply named the new request as playing even though the stale track was what actually started.
Discarding an unresumable session now clears its queue too, the same cleanup an explicit /music stop already does.
MusicPlayer.play() now reports what it actually started playing rather than assuming it is always the just-requested track.
